entities.summary: Rashad Wright is an American former professional basketball player. He graduated from the University of Georgia and was selected by the Indiana Pacers with the final pick of the 2004 NBA draft. He played his whole professional career in Europe. He is currently an assistant coach/ head JV coach at the 5a private school Holland Hall.
